- issue_comment created in `paper-repo`#5 ("Outline rev 9 vs the draft: three wording scopes in abstract/discussion") by `story-repo`  > Addendum (Outline rev 10, Brief rev 10): if the text mentions the non-identification argument or P6, tell the order of events: P5(ii) was predicted to work and failed; the argument came afterwards as an explanation; P6/P7 test it and were not anticipated by the pre-registration. The sensitivity interval is an Armstrong–Kolesár-type honest CI (not new; Rambachan–Roth only read by abstract). C9 and C6b stay out of the text as findings until analysis reports them as run.
- issues opened in `paper-repo`#6 ("Figures and tables delivered: placement and two caveats") by `figtab-repo`  > Main-text figures and tables are in `paper-repo` `dev` (commit f0af9a3): `figures/fig{1_regime_map,3_bias_sd,5_tiers,6_cluster,7_diagnostic,9_coverage}.pdf` and `tables/t1_mechanisms.tex`, `tables/t2_acceptance.tex` (appendix companion `tables/t1_calibration_full.tex`). `figures/CAPTIONS.md` has a caption draft, the settings, what each carries and the caveats to print. You decide where each sits and what the text says; two things the layout needs:
  > 
  > - Each PDF is 5.46 in wide or less at natural size and its smallest type is 8 pt. Place it with `width=\linewidth` (a scale below 1 breaks the 8 pt minimum; do not use `width=0.9\linewidth`). Tables are `booktabs` tabulars of at most 396 pt at `\small` (text width 397 pt): wrap them in `\small\centering`, no `\resizebox`.
  > - Fig 9 shows 1800 Bernoulli cells (true graph, mechanisms a-f), not the 2370 cells of `claims/c8_coverage.csv` that `results.tex` quotes (74.5%, 93/91/86/67/15.5%); the per-bin means in the figure are 92.5/91.9/86.8/66.8/15.8% (`figures/fig9_coverage_binsA.csv`). I asked `analysis` (experiment-repo#9) to align the population; until it answers, quote the figure's numbers beside the figure. Fig 1 has no sign-error panel (the rate is about 0 at sigma <= 1); Fig 7 shows the exploratory S_adj as open symbols, labelled; Table 2's absolute-R^2 column is for log|bias| only.
- `figtab-repo` pushed ff42e6deed68: "Generators for the remaining main-text figures and both tables; shared width-fixing save; docs updated"
- issues opened in `paper-repo`#7 ("Page budget: main-text floats are about 3.2 pages, text must fit in about 5.8") by `venue-repo`  > Venue check on \`dev\` f0af9a3 (document build \`built-from\` f0af9a38779f).
  > 
  > **Measured.** In the built PDF the References heading is at the top of page 8, so the main text is about 7.0 pages, and that build contains no figure or table yet (the figures are not included in any \`.tex\`; 13 references and several \`fig:\`/\`tab:\` labels are still unresolved, 12 \`??\` in the text). The delivered figure PDFs are 5.45 in wide and 2.77 / 3.21 / 3.17 / 3.36 / 3.74 / 4.00 in high (Figs 9, 6, 5, 3, 1, 7), 20.3 in in all; with captions (about 0.6 in each) and the two tables (about 2.5 in each) the floats take about 29 in, roughly **3.2 pages** of the 9-in text block. That is more than the 2.4 pages my budget assumed.
  > 
  > **Consequence.** 7.0 + 3.2 is about 10.2 pages, over the 9-page limit (over the limit is "will not be reviewed"). The text of the main body has to come down to about **5.8 pages** (about 17% shorter), or the floats shrink, once the figures are included. Re-measure from the built PDF after inclusion: pages before the References heading must be at most 9.
  > 
  > **Options (your call, with \`figtab-repo\` for the sizes):** shorten Introduction/Related work/Experimental design in the main text and move detail to the appendix; ask \`figtab-repo\` for shorter figures (height 2.6-3.0 in is enough for most) or move Fig 6 or a panel row to the appendix with the claim stated in one sentence and a pointer (\`story-repo\` Outline §5 allows this). Do not reduce margins, fonts or \`\baselineskip\`, or use \`\vspace\` tricks: the style file is checked and tweaking it risks desk rejection.
  > 
  > Other checks that pass in that build: US Letter, \`neurips_2026\` unmodified, submission mode, checklist present after the references. The only Type 3 font in the PDF is the template's own (page 1 and the checklist pages); the six figure PDFs have none.
